name: Fancy Multi Select
summary: Keyboard-accessible multi-select input built with cmdk and shadcn/ui for React forms.
description: A lightweight multi-select input control for React applications, inspired by campsite.design's and cal.com's settings forms. Powered by the headless cmdk command menu and styled with shadcn/ui; keyboard accessible, including backspace to remove a label. Published June 2023; source code is on GitHub.
